{"consolidated_memory":"PLAN DRIFT ISSUES IN infra/terraform/vpc.tf - THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

The same area of infra/terraform/vpc.tf has experienced recurring plan drift problems in the VPC module, each with different root causes and fixes. All incidents share the same signal: a diff on a resource nobody edited, reproduced by running plan twice with no changes in between.

INCIDENT 1 [2026-02-13]:
- Condition: Only appeared on the staging read replica
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #1016, branch fix/plan-drift-1
- Outcome: Flaky test went from 88 failures per hundred runs to zero

INCIDENT 2 [2026-06-08]:
- Condition: Only occurred when the input list came in empty
- Root cause: Off-by-one error in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #5314, branch fix/plan-drift-3
- Outcome: Job finished in 25 minutes instead of 4 hours

INCIDENT 3 [2026-08-19]:
- Condition: Only occurred when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: A listener registered but never removed
- Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #9222, branch fix/plan-drift-4
- Outcome: Reclaimed 21 GB of blob storage

All work was on the infrastructure side in infra/terraform/vpc.tf."}
